newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber slightly higher in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber slightly higher in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber prices were slightly higher in late trading on Friday but buying interest remained thin, traders said.
Traders said bids were heard at 46.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for August shipment, but no deals were done.

Offer prices were slightly higher at 47.00 fob Medan for June shipment against 46.25 on Thursday, at 46.50 fob Padang against 46.00, at 46.75 fob Surabaya against 46.00 and at 46.25 fob Jambi against 45.75.
Traders offered SIR20 at 46.00 fob Pontianak against 45.75 on Thursday.

"Prices continue to fall and this makes traders become unwilling to sell. Instead, traders increased their offer prices even though demand is very low, and are hoping that prices will improve soon," said one trader.

Traders said they expected market sentiment to remain poor next week because of a lack of fresh factors. "The unresolved strike at Goodyear Tire is also expected to further dampen the market sentiment," said one trader.
"If the strike is not solved, the market will become worse and worse," he added. Some traders earlier said offer prices could fall to as low as 30.00 U.S. cents/lb because of poor demand.
